first_red: Preparing already completed evidence with an unavailable external recognizer raised PreparationFailed instead of reusing its transcript.
validated_behaviors: Compatible repeated preparation reuses completed evidence without invoking recognition.
Renamed identical bytes are re-associated; changed bytes at the same path receive a different reference.
Model revision, backend/runtime version, language, decoding settings, word timing, normalization version, and selected stream invalidate incompatible speech.
Changing overview sampling and returning to an older speech configuration reuse compatible transcripts.
Concurrent CLI processes return one complete generation; an interrupted CLI writer leaves the old generation readable and can be retried.
Failed replacement preserves the previous published result; an unsuccessful attempt has its own unpublished manifest.
Corrupt artifacts are not clean cache hits. Unknown manifest versions require explicit rebuilding.
Cached speech and frames remain usable without the original; uncached frames fail clearly.
Results carry source availability and generation/frame identifiers.

natural_recording_measurement.note: Local measurement during implementation, with model files already downloaded. It is not a performance guarantee. Older generations accumulate without automatic eviction.

implementation: POSIX advisory locks, immutable generation manifests, atomic publication, content checksums, and a small per-frame cache. No database, worker service, or cleanup scheduler.
